contributions.statement: In coding-agent session logs, staged incremental direction correlated weakly positively with success while upfront acceptance criteria correlated weakly negatively.
contributions.evidence: §5.2 Table 2: coefficients +0.013 to +0.025 and -0.017 to -0.027; correlational, confounded by task difficulty, scored by an unvalidated Qwen3-4B judge; authors call signs 'sometimes contradictory'.

reason: A trait-mining method with tiny, confounded correlations and its own admission that traits are not stable skills; nothing should change a spec-driven rollout on this evidence.
